title: Reopening a connector's settings after connect never displays the raw access/refresh token
steps: Open the settings/details view for a connected integration
Inspect any field that shows credential/token information
expectedResult: Only the masked form (e.g. '****xyz9') is shown; the raw token value never appears in the DOM, network response payload rendered to the field, or any tooltip.

title: A connector's last-sync timestamp and status badge update immediately after a manual sync completes
steps: Trigger a manual sync for the integration
Wait for the sync job to complete
Refresh or observe the integration card / sync-jobs page
expectedResult: The card's 'last synced' timestamp updates to the completion time and the status badge reflects success (not a stale 'never synced' or leftover 'running' state).

title: Disconnect action requires an explicit confirmation step before deactivating the integration
steps: Click 'Disconnect' on a connected integration card
Observe whether a confirmation dialog appears before the action is applied
expectedResult: A confirmation dialog/prompt appears; dismissing it (Cancel) leaves the integration connected/unchanged; only confirming actually calls the disconnect API.

title: Connect/Disconnect/Reconfigure controls are hidden or disabled for a user role without MANAGE_CONNECTORS permission
preconditions: A user role granted integration.read (can view the Hub) but not MANAGE_CONNECTORS
steps: Log in as the read-only integrations user
Open /integrations and inspect each connector card
expectedResult: Cards render in read-only form: no 'Connect', 'Disconnect', or 'Configure' action is available/enabled for this user, even though the catalog itself is visible.

title: Evidence detail page's 'Source' field never shows blank/undefined for evidence imported via an integration
preconditions: At least one evidence item imported via an integration sync
steps: Open the evidence detail page for an integration-sourced evidence item
expectedResult: The 'Source' field always shows a real connector type name (e.g. 'github (automated)'), never a blank value, 'undefined (automated)', or a raw internal enum key.
